name: Tax Voucher 5
definition: Specifies tax vouchers in the framework of a corporate action event.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique reference for the tax voucher required by the relevant tax authorities to ensure that any claim relating to this particular tax voucher cannot be duplicated.

BargainDate.name: Bargain Date
BargainDate.definition: Date on which a dividend reinvestment purchase was completed. If there is only one bargain involved, the time it was struck needs to be included.

BargainSettlementDate.name: Bargain Settlement Date
BargainSettlementDate.definition: Settlement date of the dividend reinvestment purchase transaction.
